These three scores and their synthesized recordings were created for this project
by scripts/compose-ambient-candidates.py. No third-party samples were used.
Dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0 Universal:
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
No attribution required. These are synthesized timbres, not recordings of a koto.
Stable selection IDs retained; revised arrangements on 2026-10-25:
moon-washi: 60 BPM, 96 seconds, sparse koto-like minor pentatonic.
quiet-garden: 100 BPM, 96 seconds, major mallets and light percussion.
ink-ripples: 72 BPM, 120 seconds, Dorian pads, reed-like melody and swells.
